== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|A drudge is an indispensable, specialized [[Soulsmith]] [[construct]] designed to function as a multi-purpose [[assistant]] and mobile toolkit. Unlike other [[constructs]] made of manifest [[madra]], drudges often possess a more mechanical appearance with physical-looking parts. They are essential for the precise work of [[Soulsmithing]], which involves deconstructing and reconstructing [[Remnants]]. Without a drudge, performing these tasks accurately is nearly impossible. These [[constructs]] serve several analytical and practical roles. They can detect and measure [[madra]] output, identify specific [[madra]] [[aspects]], and locate valuable [[binding|bindings]] within a [[Remnant]]'s structure. They also feature tracking capabilities using antennae to find specific signatures, though these components can be fragile and expensive to replace. Beyond analysis, drudges can assist with physical tasks, such as providing height for a user, acting as a platform to stand upon, or even carrying a person through the air if powered by sufficient [[madra]]. While they can provide information and guidance, they are not a replacement for a practitioner's experience, as they only check for the specific parameters they are instructed to monitor.}}
